Avoid duplicating existing crawler channels: match by youtube_channel_id, channel_url, or fuzzy channel_name/search_name.
Assign existing channels via existing_channel_category_map; unmapped extras go to other or best-fit.
New channels from the list may be added to crawler after resolving official channel IDs; do not invent fake youtube_channel_id.
youtube_channel_id stays null until scripts/seed_channel_categories.py --resolve verifies it via the YouTube Data API or yt-dlp, or an operator sets resolved_by to manual. Do not invent channel ids.

Resolved ids were checked with yt-dlp. A row is stored only when the channel title clearly matches the search name, HK/香港 tokens are preserved, the channel has at least 1,000 subscribers, and short or lookalike names are echoed by the handle or description. Rows that failed that check stay null.
